2124805811142832587.en_summary: Wall Street firms issued bullish equity notes over the weekend. Evercore said "the wall of worry is as high as it has been in the AI era," BTIG said stocks are "very oversold," and GS said such panic is generally a "good opportunity to start adding risk."

2124805814447755700.en_summary: It is in that context that this post from @billackman got such a response. Link to BillAckman post.

TotalEnergies SE (TTE) has entered into an agreement with oilfield operator Continental Resources to acquire interests in natural gas upstream assets.
